about_the_game:
Born from the myths of the Norns, our journey begins: We awaken in Midgard, torn from a dream in which we fall from Asgard. Through the roots and branches of Yggdrasil, our fate unfolds – every deed and every decision shaping the course of the world and inevitably leading to one of two endings: to defy Ragnarök or to bring about the end of all things.

Along this path we wield swords, axes, and bows of great power. Arrows, potions, and supplies decide between victory and downfall. Odin’s companions step forth from the shadows, enchanted springs ignite new strength, and mighty bosses put our courage to the ultimate test.

Off the main path lie hidden treasures and ancient riddles – secrets that speak of worlds long forgotten.

Developed exclusively for VR, the game delivers precise hitboxes, realistic physics, and full-body presence of creatures. Weapons serve not only for attack, but also to move objects, deflect strikes, or even block arrows in flight – turning every encounter into an intense, tangible experience. Fly with Hugin, ride with Sleipnir, and fight alongside Freki.

Ragnarök – Fate of the Gods

Ragnarök is often translated as “Twilight of the Gods,” a reading introduced by Snorri Sturluson and later popularized by Wagner. However, the more accurate meaning of Ragnarök is “Fate of the Gods.” It does not merely describe a twilight or decline, but the inevitable course of their destiny – a nuance that adds even greater depth to the Norse myths.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350 or newer
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 103 GB available space
  • Sound Card: VR-Headset
  • VR Support: SteamVR, OpenXR, HP Motion
  • Additional Notes: *VR-Headset
